highlights.title: TETHYS Wetness under GAIA
highlights.description: Bake Wetness from a GAIA water simulation: fabrics soak, darken, dry and shed water by material, with each Material Zone behaving on its own.

highlights.title: Real drops and runoff
highlights.description: Water beads into drops of every size, runners leave trails, rivulets form on slopes, and a sheet pulled out of water tears into holes before it breaks into drops.

highlights.title: Texture only, render ready
highlights.description: Wetness and a water normal map play as image sequences in your materials. No extra geometry; Clear Wetness restores the material exactly.
